standard_prerequisites.name: Nakayama's lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, the lemma allowing the surjectivity of a map of finite modules to be checked modulo a nilpotent ideal
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the two reductions by which surjectivity of A -> B is checked on the quotients by the maximal ideal of A.

standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of the cotangent sequence for the residue field
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The standard exact sequence relating the cotangent space of Lambda, that of an Artinian algebra and the relative cotangent space
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the displayed commutative diagram with exact rows, which transfers surjectivity between the absolute and relative cotangent spaces.

core_obligations: First implication (proof lines 576-587): since the maximal ideals consist of the nilpotent elements, a surjective f maps m_A into m_B; given y in m_B and a preimage x, the induced isomorphism on residue fields forces x to lie in m_A, so the induced map on cotangent spaces is surjective.

Second and third equivalent (proof lines 589-600): the implication from the absolute to the relative cotangent space is immediate, and the displayed commutative diagram with exact rows shows conversely that surjectivity of the relative map implies surjectivity of the absolute one.

Third implies the first (proof lines 602-610): by Nakayama's lemma applied twice, it suffices to show that m_A B maps onto m_B modulo m_B^2, i.e. that m_A B/m_A m_B surjects onto m_B/m_B^2, which is exactly the assumed surjectivity of the relative cotangent spaces.
proof_roadmap: Use the nilpotence of the maximal ideals and the isomorphism on residue fields for the first implication.
Compare the absolute and relative cotangent spaces through the standard exact diagram.
Apply Nakayama's lemma twice to recover surjectivity of the ring map.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a ring map in the category of Artinian algebras, surjectivity, surjectivity on the absolute cotangent spaces and surjectivity on the relative cotangent spaces are equivalent (statement lines 563-574). The proof (proof lines 576-612) uses the nilpotence of the maximal ideals for the first implication, the standard exact diagram for the comparison of the two cotangent spaces, and Nakayama's lemma twice for the converse. H2: three implications with two inputs, written out in full.
